title: Working Student - Internal Communications
description:
Back to jobs Working Student - Internal Communications Munich | Hybrid Apply Your Role Want to see how a fast-growing space tech company keeps everyone on the same page, and help make that happen? As our Working Student in Internal Communications, you’ll join us in Munich and work closely with leadership and teams across the company. Your job is to make sure the right information reaches the right people, clearly and on time. You’ll help turn leadership priorities into messages people actually read, keep our weekly team meetings sharp and well-prepared, and make every internal presentation look and sound like constellr. As we scale across satellite tech, Commercial and operations, your work will help keep our team aligned, informed and connected to the mission. Key responsibilities Coordinate and prepare our weekly team meetings: collect updates from teams, build the agenda and slides, and follow up on key takeaways Support leadership with “top down” messaging, turning company news, strategy updates and decisions into clear, engaging communication for the whole team Create and polish internal presentations, making sure every deck reflects our corporate branding and visual identity Help maintain and develop our brand guidelines, templates and internal communication assets Drive ongoing transparency by keeping a regular flow of updates across channels such as our intranet, Teams and newsletters Keep the internal comms calendar up to date so announcements are well-timed and nothing falls through the cracks Contribute ideas to improve how we share information, gather feedback and build a strong, connected company culture Job requirements About you Required: You’re currently enrolled at a university or Hochschule in Germany and available for up to 20 hours per week during the semester Excellent written and spoken English, with a talent for making complex topics clear and concise Strong presentation skills and a good eye for design: you know what makes a slide work Strong organisational skills and attention to detail: you like deadlines met and information that’s accurate Confidence working with senior stakeholders and collecting input from busy teams Discretion and good judgement when handling sensitive or confidential information Comfort in a fast-paced scale-up: you keep priorities clear and adapt when things change Able to work from our Munich office 2 days a week Nice to Have: First experience in communications, marketing, PR or a similar role (an internship, part-time job or student society role all count) Studies in communications, media, marketing, business or a related field Experience with PowerPoint, Canva, Figma or similar design tools Familiarity with intranet platforms or collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint German language skills Interest in space tech, defence or climate Why join constellr? High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies. Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match. Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers. Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy. Financial Upside & Well-being: Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models.
